basic_info.description: There's nothing quite like this in San Francisco. A rare opportunity to own a truly unique 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home, PLUS a large family/media room and a top floor den that opens to a large walk out deck.  Boasting expansive, breathtaking views of the full span Golden Gate Bridge and sweeping northern vistas from every level, this home has been impeccably remodeled with luxurious finishes and state-of-the-art features. Highlights include a redone kitchen, fresh paint throughout, newly refinished and laid hardwood floors, and brand-new light fixtures. Sumptuous primary suite offers unparalleled views, making it a serene retreat.  The home absolutely shines and one appreciates all it has to offer with attention to every detail. An elevator provides convenient access to all levels, excluding the top floor, directly from the garage with two car side by side inside parking & a courtyard for guests that can also accommodate up to an additional 3 cars. Situated on iconic Broadway, the location offers unparalleled convenience, with easy access to Fillmore Street, Union Street, Alta Plaza Park, and some of the City's top private schools just a short distance away. An opportunity like this home does not come along very often!!
